news.title: MARTA names Jonathan Hunt permanent general manager, CEO
news.summary: The Metropolitan Atlanta Rapid Transit Authority Board of Directors has chosen a new permanent general manager and chief executive officer during its regularly scheduled meeting Thursday.

news.title: 'Y'all got me sir': Video shows officers chasing suspected thief across I-75
news.summary: Police body-cam footage shows the suspect crossing active lanes of traffic on I-75 while police follow him.

news.title: Atlanta man whose sentence Biden commuted faces drug charge
news.summary: Atlanta resident Walter Lee Muhammad, 46, is facing new federal drug charges less than two years after then-President Joe Biden commuted his 10-year fentanyl trafficking sentence.

news.title: Train crashes into tractor-trailer, shuts road down
news.summary: Henry County Police have asked drivers to avoid Old Griffin Road and Racetrack Road Thursday morning.

news.title: Coroner to discuss new review of Heather Turner’s 2017 death
news.summary: Paulding County Coroner Lindsey Eberhart Fuller will hold a news conference at 3 p.m. Thursday to discuss the renewed review of Heather Turner's 2017 death.

news.title: Arkansas woman missing after traveling to Stone Mountain
news.summary: Stone Mountain police are searching for Sherry Wages, 72, who left Hot Springs, Arkansas, in March and traveled to Georgia.

news.title: Man found dead in apartment building in DeKalb County, police say
news.summary: No suspect has been identified at this time.

news.title: 2 dead, 1 injured after string of DeKalb County shootings overnight
news.summary: Two men were killed in separate shootings less than 30 minutes apart Wednesday night in DeKalb County. Another man was wounded.

news.title: ‘I will kill y'all’: Middle school student arrested for gun on Cobb campus
news.summary: A student brought a gun to Campbell Middle School in Smyrna on Tuesday, just seven days into the new school year.

news.title: Violent criminal sentenced to prison for trafficking large amounts of fentanyl, meth in Gwinnett
news.summary: Based on evidence presented in court, 46-year-old Gabriel Ojeda Murguia sold fentanyl and methamphetamine on several occasions in Gwinnett County for a year.

news.title: Fourth arrest made in case of Atlanta man killed, found dumped in Douglas County reservoir
news.summary: The Douglas County Sheriff's Office said a deceased male was first recovered from Dog River Reservoir on May 15.
